title: Chicken Tagine with Algerian Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired dish with the warm spices of India, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add Algerian spice blend and cook for another minute.
Add tagine sauce and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with garlic and serve with basmati rice or naan bread.
